tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards; also the web app's meta theme-color.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card and sheet background, always on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text on card or surface (17.9:1 on card).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Descriptions and captions on card (7.5:1) or surface (6.9:1).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The action color: floating button, avatar, step numerals, links. White on it is 5.2:1; on surface it is 4.8:1.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: Tonal pill buttons and step circles. Kept from the app: primary text on it is only 4.4:1, so small labels use primary-strong.

tokens.name: primary-strong
tokens.usage: Proposed: blue text on primary-tint at small sizes (4.9:1), e.g. button-sm labels.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Yallist orange: the logo, the app icon, and the proposed ‘brought it’ check. Graphics only on light grounds (3.1:1 on card); never text or buttons.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Proposed: orange text on card when it must read as the brand, e.g. ‘you’re bringing this’ (5.0:1).

tokens.name: illo-sky
tokens.usage: Empty-state illustration only: sky.

tokens.name: illo-sun
tokens.usage: Empty-state illustration only: sun.

tokens.name: illo-hill
tokens.usage: Empty-state illustration only: far hills.

tokens.name: illo-hill-deep
tokens.usage: Empty-state illustration only: near hills.

tokens.name: illo-water
tokens.usage: Empty-state illustration only: water.

tokens.name: illo-tent
tokens.usage: Empty-state illustration only: tent.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per screen, at the start edge of the header.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: פותחים טיול, שולחים קישור לחברים, ובוחרים ביחד מי מביא מה.

styles.name: item-title
styles.usage: Titles of list rows and steps, in ink.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Second line under an item-title, in ink-muted.

styles.name: step-number
styles.usage: Numerals inside step circles, primary on primary-tint.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Countdowns and stat values; tabular digits so counts don't shift.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between an item-title and its caption.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a section-title and its body text inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between cards; header to first card; step circle to its text; icon to label in the floating button.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card inner padding; tonal button inline padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between step rows; floating button inline padding and its gap from the bottom edge.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the single content column on web and tablets.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, and the top corners of an illustration that opens a card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, avatars, step circles.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: The app-icon tile when drawn in the UI. Store icons ship full-bleed; the OS masks the corners.

tokens.name: size-step
tokens.usage: Step-number circle.

tokens.name: size-avatar
tokens.usage: Header avatar; also the minimum touch target.

tokens.name: size-button-sm
tokens.usage: Tonal pill button height.

tokens.name: size-button-lg
tokens.usage: Floating primary button height.

tokens.name: size-ring-hero
tokens.usage: ProgressRing on the trip hero.

tokens.name: size-ring-card
tokens.usage: ProgressRing on a trip card.

tokens.name: size-ring-status
tokens.usage: The row check (StatusRing).

tokens.name: size-spot
tokens.usage: A 4:3 crop of a scene, or a state spot.

tokens.name: avatar-xs
tokens.usage: Avatar sizes: xs 24, sm 28 (stacks), md 32, lg 44, xl 56, xxl 96 (profile).

tokens.name: avatar-sm
tokens.usage: AvatarStack.

tokens.name: avatar-md
tokens.usage: Default avatar.

tokens.name: avatar-lg
tokens.usage: Header avatar, people rows.

tokens.name: avatar-xl
tokens.usage: Large avatar.

tokens.name: avatar-xxl
tokens.usage: Profile picture.

tokens.name: progress-fill
tokens.usage: Rings and bars. Graphics only: the count is always shown beside them (brand on line is 2.2:1).

tokens.name: progress-track
tokens.usage: Ring and bar track; visible at 0%.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: Presses, small state changes.

tokens.name: motion-base
tokens.usage: Ring and bar fills, counts.

tokens.name: motion-slow
tokens.usage: Larger movements.

tokens.name: motion-celebrate
tokens.usage: Celebrations (the longest motion).

tokens.name: easing-out
tokens.usage: The one easing curve.

tokens.name: is-rtl
tokens.usage: The app is Hebrew-only; code reads this constant, never I18nManager.isRTL (false on react-native-web).

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Only the floating primary button. Cards stay flat.
